name: Saints Martha, Mary, and Lazarus
notes: The five existing Scripture appointments retain their 1981 Ordo lectionum Missae evidence and data unchanged: artifact page 352, printed page 298, no. 607, then headed S. Marthae and De Communi sanctarum, with the proper-Gospel instruction. That Common cue is reading evidence only. The decree dated 26 January 2021, Prot. N. 35/21, and its complete official annex directly identify the expanded 29 July memorial and its five Missal roles; each is represented here as a held-unpublished body without wording. The annex gives only the amended Lectionary title at no. 607 and supplies no replacement reading course. Its separate Common of Saints referral belongs to the Liturgy of the Hours and creates no Missal Common choice. The Missal section prints no Common referral or alternative. The Collect and two other orations retain their abbreviated conclusion-cue boundaries in source notes; no expansion is supplied. These are exact 2021 addition facts, not a complete-2008 or 2008-Common correspondence. A separate complete U.S. English formulary is held under the confirmation of 30 September 2024, Prot. n. 431/24; the five exact English accounting rows retain that territorial and edition identity without activating wording. Its effective and promulgation dates remain unestablished. Neither source identification nor confirmation grants body publication permission. Source authority: passage.catholic-church.roman-calendar-martha-mary-lazarus-additions-2021.2021-official-latin-decree-and-annex.decree-calendar-and-annex-authority; section boundaries: passage.catholic-church.roman-calendar-martha-mary-lazarus-additions-2021.2021-official-latin-decree-and-annex.book-boundaries.
